title: The commit claims 'N1' duplicate in overlay_check' cleaned, but the duplicated DOCK-RIGHT sentence still ships twice, 4 lines apart
detail: Fix commit 2709e63 message lists 'comment staleness fixed (N1' duplicate in overlay_check ...)'; the same sentence is still pasted twice in overlay_check. Claimed fix did not land.
recommended_fix: Delete the first of the two DOCK-RIGHT comment blocks (keep the one adjacent to view_set_rail/view_refit).

title: The commit claims 'N7' Open Sans->Plex Mono' cleaned, but draw_noc_panel's doc still says 'Open Sans digits' while measuring with v.font_mono (Plex Mono)
detail: Only the file-header occurrence (line 20) was updated; the prior finding's exact location (the draw_noc_panel doc, r2-N7' at old line 617) still names the wrong font. Fix claim is half-delivered.
recommended_fix: Change 'Open Sans digits' to 'Plex Mono digits' in draw_noc_panel's doc comment (line 624).

title: noc_class_columns' new ONE-source comment claims the overlay-pixels smoke reads it — the smoke never references it
detail: Repo-wide grep: noc_class_columns is referenced only by noc_overlay.odin and noc_overlay_test.odin; harness/overlay.odin reads noc_panel_rect only. A fresh overclaiming comment from the commit that cleaned stale ones.
recommended_fix: Drop 'and the overlay-pixels smoke' from the comment (readers: the draw + the header/data rows + the test pins).

title: tray_chip_hit adds a third hand-copied tray hit-test loop, against the repo's own 'ONE copy — no hand-duplicated hit-test to drift' doctrine
detail: Three loops must now agree on chip geometry forever; B1'' was exactly a draw/hit-test divergence. The helper also takes ^App though it only reads app.view — unneeded coupling.
recommended_fix: Add tray_chip_at(v: ^View, pos) -> int (or bool) in render/tray.odin beside tray_chip_rect; have mouse.odin, exec.odin and main.odin delegate to it.

title: The swallow's yield-whitelist covers only the tray; the clickable SLA focus rows (hit rect x 8..748, drawn post-rail in draw_hud) extend over the plate at win_w < 1272 and get eaten
detail: At the supported min window the plate starts at x=628; SLA rows' hit/highlight rect runs to 748 and sla_focus_click sits below the swallow, so clicks in the 628..748 band die silently. Marginal (glyphs end ~x350), but the hand-enumerated whitelist is the fragility.
recommended_fix: Either also yield to sla_row_rect hits, or bound the swallow rect to the rail's content region (y >= NOC_CONTENT_Y) so HUD bands over the plate stay live.
